style: Match the attached approved kingfisher reference ONLY for naturalistic watercolor and fine coloured-pencil rendering, detailed feather texture and restrained field-guide lighting. Replace the kingfisher completely with the specified species. Do not copy its blue/orange colours, proportions, facing or props. Output one new original bird illustration, never a panel or montage. No text, labels, logos, shadow, checkerboard or paper rectangle. Real transparent alpha background. No anatomy inventions: exactly two wings/flippers in total (far folded wing can be hidden), one head and one bill, correct feet/toes. An open wing replaces its folded outline on that side; never add an extra folded wing.

primary.direction: PRIMARY compact portrait: whole bird in a natural resting/standing upright posture facing RIGHT. Closed wings (relaxed flippers for penguin), natural visible feet, beak/tail/toes fully inside image, bird occupies about 85% of canvas. Bird ONLY: no branch, perch, rock, ground, plants, water, food or shadow. Not flying, not crouching. Use a species-appropriate natural body carriage; a duck and penguin need not sit like a songbird.

dynamic.direction: DYNAMIC species-page hero: distinct species-specific behavior/vignette as described below. Large bird, centered slightly left with ample room in front of its bill, about 80-90% of available frame. Natural minimal habitat accents only; genuine alpha transparency around scene. All heads, bills and bird parts inside master image; the app may bleed the sides. No hard crop along the TOP: branches/trunks must end naturally or fade transparently before the top edge. Avoid excessive empty top/right space and avoid a beige paper background copied from the reference.

species.fieldMarks: Slate-grey upperparts, fine rufous barring on whitish underparts, red iris, long barred tail, small hooked bill; a small accipiter, not a falcon.
species.dynamicScene: Alert on a short naturally ending thorny branch, body right-facing, head turned slightly toward viewer, wings folded.

species.fieldMarks: Grey upperparts, very long slender tail, yellow vent and underparts, black breeding throat with pale moustachial border, slim insect-eating bill and pinkish-brown legs; not a yellow-backed wagtail.
species.dynamicScene: On a rounded wet stone beside a small fast-flowing stream, tail lifted slightly in a natural tail-bobbing pose; a few delicate water ripples only.

species.fieldMarks: Red bill, white crescent above eye, orange cheek whiskers, purple breast and paired orange sail-like tertials; compact duck proportions and orange webbed feet.
species.dynamicScene: Swimming right-facing with correctly folded wings and orange sail tertials, subtle ripples fading out; no solid water backdrop.

species.fieldMarks: Cryptic warm brown leaf-litter plumage, transverse dark crown bars, very large high-set dark eye, long straight bill, compact plump body and short legs; not a snipe with longitudinal crown stripes.
species.dynamicScene: Probing soft leaf litter with its long bill, head and entire bill inside the canvas, leaves restricted to a small fading patch.

species.fieldMarks: Dark brown body and wings, pale cream crown and throat, long yellow legs, long broad wings and long tail; avoid male grey wing/tail panels or an eagle build.
species.dynamicScene: Quartering low over a few reed tips, gentle three-quarter bank, two naturally extended wings, feet tucked, all plumage consistent with the same adult female.

species.fieldMarks: Small olive-brown leaf warbler, pale buff-white underparts, subdued pale eyebrow, dark legs and fine pointed bill; restrained olive tones, not a bright yellow finch.
species.dynamicScene: Gleaning a tiny insect from the underside of a few leaves on one short naturally ending twig, lively but anatomically simple posture, wings folded.

species.fieldMarks: Large tawny-rufous fish owl, dark longitudinal streaking, conspicuous yellow eyes, outward ear tufts, strong bill and largely bare lower legs and powerful fishing toes; not a brown fish owl.
species.dynamicScene: Leaning forward alertly from a low streamside rock toward clear water, both feet naturally gripping, one small fern and limited water accents; wings folded.

species.fieldMarks: Great Curassow: glossy black plumage, crisp white vent/lower belly, prominent curled black crest and yellow knob at the base of the bill, long tail and strong grey legs. Do not make a brown female or a turkey.
species.dynamicScene: Walking through a small tropical forest-floor vignette toward fallen fruit; curled crest and yellow bill knob clearly visible, wings folded, leaves and roots fade out.

species.fieldMarks: African Penguin: black back, white belly with individual black spots and one black breast band, black face with broad white facial border and pink bare patch above eye, black feet; two flippers only, no second breast band.
species.dynamicScene: Swimming underwater right-facing in a shallow three-quarter side view, two natural flippers, subtle bubbles and a few seaweed tips fading to transparency; no rectangular blue background.

species.fieldMarks: Eastern Red-rumped Swallow Cecropis daurica: blue-black upperparts, rusty nape and rump, pale warm underparts with fine dark streaks, long deeply forked dark tail streamers and small bill; not a barn swallow or European Cecropis rufula.
species.dynamicScene: Graceful three-quarter side flight catching a small insect, two open wings with natural joints and no extra folded wing on a flank; long forked tail fully shown, sparse aerial composition.
